relocation_line: I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start two weeks after an offer.
cover_letter_text:
Hello,

I am applying for the Graduate Civil Engineer role at BenchHDC in Port Adelaide, advertised on SEEK. Your newly created position, covering project coordination, tender preparation and estimating, quality documentation and site inspections on horizontal directional drilling projects, is the broad, hands-on start I am looking for.

I hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering (Philippines, 2019) and completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in Australia in February 2026. In it I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in AutoCAD and Civil 3D, and prepared cost estimates, bills of quantities and risk registers. On site in the Philippines in 2019 and 2020 I coordinated 10 to 15 workers a day as project-in-charge, carried out site inspections and quality checks, tracked procurement and materials, and prepared progress reports.

I am based in Melton VIC. I will relocate to Adelaide for this role and can start two weeks after an offer. Full working rights in Australia (Subclass 485 visa), no sponsorship needed. I hold a driver's licence and a White Card. Could we arrange a call?

Marc Masarate
